channel.description: Latest articles from Best Little Sites (comicbookmovie.com)

item.title: ASTONISHING MILES MORALES: SPIDER-MAN Expands Cody Ziglar's Run With New One-Shot This May
item.description: While we wait to find out what the future holds in store for Miles Morales in the Marvel Universe, this May will see the release of a special one-shot, Astonishing Miles Morales: Spider-Man #1.

item.title: THE SUPER MARIO GALAXY MOVIE Posters Highlight The Franchise's New And Returning Characters
item.description: Nintendo and Illumination have released seven new posters for The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, featuring Mario, Luigi, Bowser, Princess Peach and Toad, Rosalina, Bowser Jr., Yoshi, and more.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Official Promo Banner Features Scorpion, Boomerang, The Hulk, And More
item.description: Some more Spider-Man: Brand New Day promo art has been shared online via a banner spotlighting character designs for several villains the webhead will be facing off against in the movie...

item.title: UPDATE: CIVIL WAR And ULTIMATES Writer Mark Millar Writing STAR WARS/AVENGERS Comic For Marvel
item.description: The first Marvel and Star Wars comic book crossover is reportedly happening, with Kick-Ass writer Mark Millar returning to Marvel Comics for Star Wars/Avengers.

item.title: LOVE STORY Star Paul Anthony Kelly Rumored To Be In Line For DCU Role; Could He Play Batman?
item.description: Love Story star Paul Anthony Kelly is reportedly in line for a role in the DCU, and fan speculation is already pointing to him suiting up as The Brave and the Bold's Batman.

item.title: HIGHLANDER: Henry Cavill's Blood-Soaked Connor MacLeod Rides A Motorcyle In Latest Set Photos
item.description: These latest photos from the set of the Highlander reboot feature Man of Steel star Henry Cavill as immortal warrior Connor MacLeod as he prepares to ride away on a motorcycle...

item.title: WONDER WOMAN: Adria Arjona Rumored To Be James Gunn's "No. 1 Choice" To Play The DCU's Diana
item.description: Adria Arjona is a popular fan-pick to play Wonder Woman, and a new rumor claims that the Andor star is indeed on James Gunn's radar to play the DCU's Diana...

item.title: PREDATOR: BADLANDS Director Details Scrapped Cameos From ALIEN And PREDATOR Franchise Icons
item.description: Predator: Badlands director Dan Trachtenberg has confirmed that an earlier version of the movie featured surprise cameos from characters from the wider Alien and Predator franchises.

item.title: THE BATMAN 2's Working Title Revealed; Writer Mattson Tomlin Says Sequel "Feels New And Dangerous"
item.description: The Batman Part 2's working title has been revealed before shooting begins this Spring. Writer Mattson Tomlin, meanwhile, has said the "bar couldn't be higher" for the upcoming sequel.

item.title: MCU Rumor Roundup: Scorpion's SPIDER-MAN: BND Costume; Ant-Man's New AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Man-Crush, & More
item.description: In this MCU rumor roundup, we have a disappointing update on the costume Scorpion will don in Spider-Man: Brand New Day, and a fun detail about Ant-Man's role in Avengers: Doomsday...
